x-ecosystem-packaging.adapterIsolation: src/adapter.js is the only module that talks to the DSH llm service; src/native.js reaches ctx.settings and ctx.tools, and the only @deepseek-ai/* import in the package is the schemastery schema builder.
x-ecosystem-packaging.runtime: Both keyless lanes are reached directly over HTTPS from the plugin process; there is no runtime download, child process or local port. The free lane's v2 wire contract is carried verbatim in src/o2a/ from dsh-our-free-model (MIT).
x-ecosystem-packaging.ios: Host-only by design: the browser half never runs in Fish Pocket, so lane preferences are a settings namespace the native form renders and lane actions — including the recycle bin — are tools. src/actions.js is the single implementation shared with the web API.
x-ecosystem-packaging.provenance: 业务逻辑移植自 https://github.com/trexwb/wbBridge；线契约收录自 https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model
